canada.summary: A talented young football player from Halifax, Nova Scotia, who was set to play in the NCAA next year has died while attending a boarding school in the United States.

canada.title: Punk rock flea market in Winnipeg a 'great democratization of art,' vendor says
canada.summary: Volunteers and vendors of a twice-yearly Winnipeg flea market say it's about more than just punk music, drawing a wide range of community members to an equally diverse selection of artists.

canada.title: Life inside the ‘missing middle:’ Edmonton multiplex dwellers share their thoughts on the infill debate
canada.summary: With the future of infill now in question in Edmonton, CBC News interviewed more than a dozen residents who live in new multiplex developments in mature neighbourhoods. Residents shared why they chose this type of housing, what they like and dislike about it, and how they feel about the debates surrounding it. Most said they understand concerns about multiplexes and in some cases share them, but they also want more people to know why single-family homes may not be the right choice for everyone.

canada.title: Early start to flu season may test Alberta hospital capacity
canada.summary: Flu season is arriving early this year, which could spell trouble for hospital capacity in the province.

canada.title: Mining advocates to weigh in at court hearing on First Nation's proposed staking ban
canada.summary: The Yukon Supreme Court has granted the Yukon Chamber of Mines intervenor status at an upcoming hearing about a mineral claims staking ban sought by the First Nation Na-cho Nyäk Dun on its traditional territory.

canada.title: N.L.’s top-billing doctor faces malpractice lawsuits from 2 former patients
canada.summary: The ophthalmologist who was Newfoundland and Labrador's top-billing doctor for the last two years straight is being sued by two former patients, including one who says his right eye was completely blinded during a botched cataract surgery.

canada.title: Saint John data centre would pay property tax equivalent to 8 oil refineries, study suggests
canada.summary: A report suggesting that a controversial data centre complex proposed for Saint John would eventually pay the city property taxes equivalent to eight large oil refineries has municipal officials dreaming big but wondering if it can be true.

canada.title: Moncton mulls options to prevent future flooding
canada.summary: The City of Moncton has started to consider its options for mitigating the impacts of flooding, including to a berm along the waterfront or raise Assomption Boulevard that would cost up to $15 million.

canada.title: Whitehorse veterinarian bringing pet care to Dawson City through a new clinic
canada.summary: Nora Vom Endt is a veterinarian based in Whitehorse. She is starting a new veterinary clinic in Dawson City next spring. Her clinic will be located in the town's downtown core and will offer similar services to clinics down South.

canada.title: St. John's, province having 'open and frank' talks on open drug use, public safety
canada.summary: The mayor of St. John's says there's been "open and frank discussions" behind the scenes with the provincial government on how to address public safety and open drug use concerns in the capital city.

canada.title: Montreal students reeling from police violence at Nov. 13 education austerity protest
